periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique; the primary axes of both patches are angled inward toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval; the patches exhibit vertical elongation compared to horizontal width.
